events.title: v0.1.91 - Brighter Underwater, Trash Collector and Tutorial Improvements
events.summary: Hi everyone, 😄Thank you to everyone who has been playing the Aqua Factory Simulator demo and sharing feedback, reports, and suggestions.This week’s update brings changes to Trash Collector bonuses, brighter underwater environments, and clearer tutorial guidance. We’ve also rewritten the Tablet’s Tutorial content, improved menus and controller navigation, and addressed several issues involving crates, customers, and machine placement.All changes below are available in the latest demo.Main Updates

events.title: Aqua Factory Simulator Joins Steam Next Fest: Bring Your Crew!
events.summary: Hi everyone, 😄We’re bringing aquatic farming, factory automation, and co-op to Steam Next Fest: October 2026!Aqua Factory Simulator will participate from October 19 to October 26, 2026. Whether you’re planning to build your business solo or share the work with friends, we’d love to welcome you to the coast.And you don’t have to wait for the festival.
